prompt: The Splice project {project} holds a fresh screen recording of a TextEdit window. Turn it into a polished vertical TikTok: 9:16, the window filling the frame (no black bands), a colorful background frame around it, a bigger cursor with click rings, zoom toward clicks, and the music track at {upbeat} mixed in at social loudness. Then export it with the social preset. Use the splice MCP tools only.

checks.name: no letterbox bands
checks.expr: not frame(max(1, sum(c['length'] for c in clips) // 2)).bands()

checks.name: background frame
checks.expr: (effect('window') or {}).get('background', 'gradient') != 'none' and effect('window') is not None

checks.name: zoom
checks.expr: effect('clickZoom') is not None or any(i['kind'] == 'motion' for i in items)

checks.name: music on the timeline
checks.expr: any(i['kind'] == 'sound' and media_kind(i['params']['media']) == 'audio' and i['params']['volume'] > 0 for i in items)
